mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying partly cloudy skies near the Military Ridge State Trail with a temperature of 76 degrees.

The city has two major updates. First, the Department of Public Works is seeking an Engineering Technician to oversee construction projects through September 20. Second, the Common Council recently approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover essential system maintenance and prevent service failures.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, head downtown for the Dane County Farmers Market or enjoy the music series at Paddy Mac's.
On August 15, officers responded to a call regarding a driver swerving on the road. The operator was found unresponsive behind the wheel and was subsequently arrested for a first offence O W I.
Today's delicious flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The shop is open until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
